name: NotificationCenter
label: Notification centre
description: A persistent notification inbox with unread count, filter tabs, and per-item actions.

props.name: title
props.description:
Heading shown in the header.
Note: this shadows the native `title` tooltip attribute, which NotificationCenter does not expose.

props.name: unreadCount
props.description: How many notifications are unread, shown as a badge beside the title (only announced when filter tabs carry the count). Omit to hide it.

props.name: unreadCountLabel
props.description: The unread count's text, given the count. Defaults to "<count> unread".

props.name: tabsLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the filter tablist. Defaults to "<title> filters".

props.name: onMarkAllRead
props.description:
Fires when Mark all as read is chosen from the header's options menu.
The item is disabled while `unreadCount` is zero.

props.name: markAllLabel
props.description: The options menu's mark-all-read item. Default "Mark all as read".

props.name: onClearAll
props.description: Fires when Clear all is chosen from the header's options menu, a destructive item that empties the inbox.

props.name: clearAllLabel
props.description: The options menu's clear-all item. Default "Clear all".

props.name: menuItems
props.description:
More items for the header's options menu, after Mark all as read and
before Clear all, such as notification settings or a link to the full
page.

props.name: optionsLabel
props.description: The options button's accessible name and tooltip. Default "Notification options".

props.name: tabs
props.description: Filter tabs under the header, each with an optional count.

props.name: value
props.description:
Value of the active filter tab, for controlled use. Leave it undefined to
let the component keep its own selection, seeded from `defaultValue`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
Value of the tab active on first render when the tabs are uncontrolled.
Falls back to the first tab.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the newly selected tab's value.

props.name: activeTab
props.description: Legacy name for `value`; `value` wins when both are set.

props.name: defaultTab
props.description: Legacy name for `defaultValue`; `defaultValue` wins when both are set.

props.name: onTabChange
props.description: Legacy change callback; fires alongside `onValueChange`.

props.name: onSeeAll
props.description:
Opens the full list of notifications. When given (or `seeAllHref`), a
footer under the list carries a See all button.

props.name: seeAllHref
props.description: Opens the full list at this address instead: the See all button becomes a link.

props.name: seeAllLabel
props.description: The See all button's label. Default "See all".

props.name: linkComponent
props.description:
The component the See all link renders with, such as Next.js's `Link`.
Wins over a LinkProvider's; a plain `<a>` when neither is set.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: What to render when there are no children — defaults to a built-in empty state.

props.name: emptyStateLabels
props.description:
The built-in empty state's copy, merged over the English defaults: title
"Nothing new", description "Notifications will collect here as they
arrive." Ignored when `emptyState` is set.

props.name: locale
props.description: The BCP 47 locale the tab counts are written in, such as `ar-EG`. Defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider's, else `en-US`.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes

props.name: children
props.description: The notifications, newest first — typically NotificationItems.

props.name: title
props.description:
One-line headline, e.g. who did what.
Note: this shadows the native `title` tooltip attribute, which NotificationItem does not expose.

props.name: time
props.description: When it happened, as already-formatted text like "2m" or "Mon".

props.name: unread
props.description: Marks the notification as not yet read: a dot beside the time and emphasised title.

props.name: unreadLabel
props.description: Visually hidden text announcing the unread dot. Defaults to "Unread".

props.name: media
props.description: Leading visual — a Material Symbol name (string) or a custom element (e.g. an Avatar).

props.name: actions
props.description: Action row under the body — typically compact Buttons like "Reply" or "Retry".

props.name: onSelect
props.description:
Opens the notification. The title becomes a button whose hit area
covers the whole row, so the row hovers and clicks as one; the action
row stays clickable on its own. Replaces the native `onSelect`
attribute, which fires on text selection inside an input.

props.name: href
props.description: Opens the notification at this address instead: the title becomes a link covering the row.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description:
Clears this one notification. A compact close button sits at the row's
end, shown on hover and focus (and always on a touch screen), above the
row's own click.

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: The dismiss button's accessible name, from the title. Default "Dismiss <title>".

props.name: linkComponent
props.description:
The component the row's link renders with, such as Next.js's `Link`, so
it navigates through the app's router. Wins over a LinkProvider's; a
plain `<a>` when neither is set.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes

props.name: children
props.description: Supporting copy under the title.

LinkComponent.description: A component that renders a link in place of a plain `<a>`, such as a router's.

LinkComponentProps.description:
The props a link component receives: every anchor attribute, the ref, and
an `href` that is always a string. Next.js's `Link` takes these as they
are; a router whose link takes `to` instead needs a one-line adapter:
`({ href, ...props }) => <RouterLink to={href} {...props} />`.

rows.text: Moves focus into the list at the selected tab, and out of the list on the next press.
Moves to the next tab and selects it.
Moves to the previous tab and selects it.
Moves to the last tab and selects it.
Moves to the first tab and selects it.
